evidence.note: Hand reaches and turns the entry-closet door handle; door is still closed.
Closet door is open and the closet contents are exposed.
Hand is on the handle while pushing the closet door shut.
Closet door is fully closed.
Hand grips the microwave handle while the door is closed.
Microwave door has swung open.
Hand pushes the open microwave door toward the appliance.
Microwave door is closed.
Hand pulls the oven handle and the door begins lowering.
Oven door is fully open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Hand lifts the oven door toward its closed position.
Oven door is fully closed.
Hand approaches the dishwasher handle while its door is closed.
Dishwasher door is open, exposing the racks.
Hand lifts the dishwasher door toward the counter.
Dishwasher door is closed.
Hand starts pulling one leaf of the upper cabinet above the sink.
A cabinet leaf has swung outward and the cabinet interior appears.
Both cabinet leaves remain visibly open.
Cabinet frontage is closed as the hand withdraws.

events.object_description: Left leaf of the double-door upper cabinet above the sink

evidence.note: The second cabinet leaf appears to be opening beside the first leaf.
Both movable cabinet leaves are visibly open around the exposed shelves.
Both leaves remain open immediately before closure.
Both cabinet leaves appear closed.

events.object_description: Right leaf of the double-door upper cabinet above the sink

evidence.note: Hand pulls the lower kitchen drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is extended and its contents are visible.
Drawer remains extended shortly before closure.
Drawer is flush with the cabinetry and closed.

events.object_description: Lower kitchen drawer beside the refrigerator

evidence.note: Hand begins pulling the upper refrigerator door.
Upper refrigerator compartment is open and illuminated.
Hand pushes the refrigerator door shut.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Hand pulls the lower freezer door handle.
Lower freezer door is open and the freezer drawers are visible.
Hand pushes the lower freezer door toward the refrigerator body.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry-closet door is closed immediately before manipulation.
Door has opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Hand pulls the laundry-closet door nearly shut.
Laundry-closet door is fully closed.

notes: Ten localized movable-part episodes are reported. The two leaves of the upper cabinet are listed separately because both are visibly open, although their individual manipulation moments occur within a sparsely sampled interval and are therefore lower confidence.
scene_description: A user moves through a compact apartment kitchen and living area, sequentially opening and closing a closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, upper cabinet leaves, drawer, refrigerator compartments, and laundry closet.
